functions.name: MARKSURFACE
functions.description: Calibrate & mark a surface under a chosen model (VV/SABR/SVI/SSVI); spills the calibrated smile + version footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Smile model: VV (market hedge), SABR, SVI or SSVI.

parameters.name: atmVol
parameters.description: At-the-money volatility (absolute, e.g. 0.102).

parameters.name: rr25
parameters.description: 25-delta risk reversal (call vol - put vol).

parameters.name: bf25
parameters.description: 25-delta butterfly (broker fly).

parameters.name: rr10
parameters.description: Optional 10-delta risk reversal (with bf10 for a 5-point smile).

parameters.name: bf10
parameters.description: Optional 10-delta butterfly.

functions.name: BARRIER
functions.description: Price a barrier option (single OR double via params): premium + 13 Greeks + footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: strikeOrDelta
parameters.description: Absolute strike or delta (25dP, ATM) of the vanilla payoff.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: barrier
parameters.description: Barrier level (single: the sole barrier; double: the LOWER barrier).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Optional KNOCK_IN (default) or KNOCK_OUT.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional UP (default) or DOWN; single-barrier only (omit for a double barrier).

parameters.name: upperBarrier
parameters.description: Optional upper barrier; supplying it makes the ticket a DOUBLE barrier.

parameters.name: rebate
parameters.description: Optional rebate paid on the barrier event (omit => 0).

parameters.name: monitoring
parameters.description: Optional CONTINUOUS (default) or DISCRETE crossing.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional booking model: ANALYTIC (default, closed-form) or LSV (local-stoch-vol; single-barrier only).

functions.name: WINDOWBARRIER
functions.description: Price a window (partial-time) barrier under the LOCAL_STOCH_VOL model: premium + (std_error if MC) + 13 Greeks + footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: strikeOrDelta
parameters.description: Absolute strike or delta (25dP, ATM) of the vanilla payoff.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: barrier
parameters.description: Knock-out barrier level (quote per 1 unit of base), e.g. 1.30.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description: Optional UP (default, up-and-out) or DOWN (down-and-out).

parameters.name: windowStart
parameters.description: Optional active-window start in years (>= 0; default 0 => front partial).

parameters.name: windowEnd
parameters.description: Optional active-window end in years (> windowStart, <= expiry; default expiry => back partial).

parameters.name: mcPairs
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo antithetic pairs (0 => exact ADI-PDE, no std-error).

parameters.name: mcSteps
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo time steps (ignored when mcPairs = 0; 0 => server default).

parameters.name: mcSeed
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo seed (bit-reproducible; ignored when mcPairs = 0).

functions.name: DIGITAL
functions.description: Price a digital (binary) option: premium + 13 Greeks + convention footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: Absolute strike level, e.g. 1.10.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for the above-strike payoff, P for the below-strike payoff.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Optional CASH_OR_NOTHING (default) or ASSET_OR_NOTHING.

parameters.name: payout
parameters.description: Optional fixed payout amount (omit => 0/unit).

functions.name: TOUCH
functions.description: Price a touch structure (one-/no-/double-no-/double-one-touch): premium + Greeks + footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Touch family: OT, NT, DNT (double-no-touch) or DOT (double-one-touch).

parameters.name: barrier
parameters.description: The (lower / sole) barrier level.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: rebate
parameters.description: Optional rebate paid when the touch condition is satisfied (omit => 0).

parameters.name: upperBarrier
parameters.description: Optional upper barrier (required for DNT/DOT; rejected for OT/NT).

parameters.name: monitoring
parameters.description: Optional CONTINUOUS (default) or DISCRETE monitoring.

functions.name: VARSWAP
functions.description: Price a variance swap: spill [fair_variance, K_var] / [fair_vol, sqrt(K_var)] + convention footer.

parameters.name: tenor

parameters.name: notional

parameters.name: strikeVol
parameters.description: Optional fixed strike vol to pin (absolute, e.g. 0.11); omit for the fair strike.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: notional

parameters.description: Optional fixed strike vol to pin (absolute, e.g. 0.11); omit for the fair strike.

functions.name: ASIAN
functions.description: Price an arithmetic-average-rate Asian option: spill [premium, PV], the 13 Greeks, + convention footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: Absolute strike level, e.g. 1.10.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: averaging
parameters.description: Optional averaging style: DISCRETE (default) or CONTINUOUS.

parameters.name: observations
parameters.description: Number of equally-spaced fixings (DISCRETE; >= 1).

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Optional analytic estimator: CURRAN (default) or TW.

parameters.name: elapsedAvg
parameters.description: Optional realised running average of the fixed observations (seasoning).

parameters.name: elapsedWeight
parameters.description: Optional fraction in [0,1) of the average already accumulated.

parameters.name: moneyness
parameters.description: Proportional strike multiplier on the reset-date spot (e.g. 1.0).

functions.name: CLIQUET
functions.description: Price a cliquet (ratchet): spill [premium, PV], (std_error if MC-priced/clamped), the 13 Greeks, + footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: moneyness
parameters.description: Proportional strike multiplier for each period leg (e.g. 1.0).

parameters.name: periods
parameters.description: Number of equal ratchet sub-periods (>= 1).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: localFloor
parameters.description: Optional per-period return floor (omit => unconstrained).

parameters.name: localCap
parameters.description: Optional per-period return cap (omit => unconstrained).

parameters.name: globalFloor
parameters.description: Optional summed-payoff floor (omit => unconstrained).

parameters.name: globalCap
parameters.description: Optional summed-payoff cap (omit => unconstrained).

parameters.name: mcPairs
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo antithetic pairs for the clamped case (0 => server default).

parameters.name: mcSeed
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo seed for the clamped case (bit-reproducible).

parameters.name: callPut

parameters.name: conversionVol

functions.name: TARF
functions.description: Price a Target-Redemption Forward (Monte-Carlo): spill [premium, PV], [std_error], the 13 Greeks, + footer.

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for the favourable-up direction, P for the classic exporter (favourable-down) TARF.

parameters.name: strike
parameters.description: Absolute strike level of every fixing, e.g. 1.10.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Cumulative client-gain target that redeems the structure (> 0).

parameters.name: leverage
parameters.description: Gearing on the adverse (loss) leg (>= 0).

parameters.name: fixings
parameters.description: Number of equally-spaced fixings (>= 1).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: redemption
parameters.description: Optional gap-risk settlement: FULL_GAIN (default) or CAPPED_GAIN.

parameters.name: fixingNotional
parameters.description: Optional notional that accrues at each fixing (omit => 1.0).

parameters.name: mcPairs
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo antithetic pairs (0 => server default).

parameters.name: mcSeed
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo seed (bit-reproducible).

functions.name: ACCUMULATOR

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: pivot

parameters.name: barrier
parameters.description: Absolute up-and-out knock-out barrier (> pivot), e.g. 1.15.

parameters.name: leverage
parameters.description: Gearing on the below-pivot (loss) leg (>= 0).

parameters.name: fixings
parameters.description: Number of equally-spaced fixings (>= 1).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: monitoring
parameters.description: Optional knock-out monitoring: DISCRETE (default) or CONTINUOUS.

parameters.name: fixingNotional
parameters.description: Optional notional that accrues at each fixing (omit => 1.0).

parameters.name: mcPairs
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo antithetic pairs (0 => server default).

parameters.name: mcSeed
parameters.description: Optional Monte-Carlo seed (bit-reproducible).

functions.name: LOOKBACK

parameters.name: pair
parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

parameters.name: style

functions.name: MARK
functions.description: Stage a manual vol/mark contribution (two-phase, idempotent; commits via the task pane).

parameters.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Tenor, e.g. 1Y.

parameters.name: pillar
parameters.description: Delta pillar (ATM, 25dP, 10dC).

parameters.name: vol
parameters.description: Absolute volatility, e.g. 0.102.

functions.name: RISK
functions.description: Server-side hierarchical risk aggregate over the org cube: spill the rolled-up node tree in a reporting numeraire.

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: Roll-up dimension: FIRM, TRADER, BOOK, DESK, PAIR, LOCATION or ENTITY.

parameters.name: numeraire
parameters.description: Reporting currency, e.g. USD (3-letter code).

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: Optional [ccy, rate] rows: numeraire units per 1 unit of ccy at spot.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional scope DIM:value (e.g. DESK:99) to narrow before the group-by.

functions.name: POSITIONS
functions.description: List the entitled open positions the cube aggregates (the desk's book) with org placement + attribution.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Optional scope DIM:value (e.g. BOOK:7) to narrow the listing (omit for all).

functions.name: LIMITS
functions.description: Limit-tree utilization + RAG for a scope node, computed server-side against the node's aggregated exposure.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope DIM:value (e.g. DESK:99) or FIRM for the firm apex.

parameters.name: numeraire
parameters.description: Reporting currency the exposures are expressed in, e.g. USD.

parameters.name: rates
parameters.description: Optional [ccy, rate] rows: numeraire units per 1 unit of ccy at spot.

functions.name: STATUS
functions.description: Live server observability: connection state, drain-side price latency (p50/p99/p99.9), celnet-fanout ring conflation drops, and surface-version / correlation provenance echo from the latest server heartbeat.
